title: EN 18286 + ISO/IEC 42001 management system
summary: One management-system programme with two sets of criteria: EN 18286:2026 for AI Act QMS readiness and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 for a certification-style audit with a Statement of Applicability, graded nonconformities and an audit recommendation.

defaults.coverageRule: Unknown, not_run, inconclusive and error do not count as pass.
defaults.statement: Diagnostics support an audit assessment and do not constitute legal compliance or a conformity certificate.

reporting.limitations: Our conclusions and recommendations do not constitute ISO/IEC 42001 certification, which only an accredited certification body grants, a conformity assessment under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, or legal advice. Clause numbers are cited without the standards' text; read them with licensed copies.

items.title: Stage 1: AIMS documentation, context and scope
items.objective: Assess whether the AI management system's context, interested parties and scope are determined and documented, and whether the system is ready for Stage 2.

procedures.text: Inspect the documented context, the list of interested parties and their relevant requirements.
Confirm that the documented scope states boundaries, AI systems and the organisation's AI roles.
Review the main AIMS documents for existence and approval before Stage 2.
Record the areas of concern to follow up in Stage 2 and whether Stage 2 can proceed.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Stage 1: Statement of Applicability review
items.objective: Assess whether the Statement of Applicability lists every Annex A control with a justified inclusion or exclusion and its implementation status.

procedures.text: Obtain the organisation's current Statement of Applicability and its approval record.
Check that every Annex A control has an inclusion or exclusion decision with a justification.
Check that each included control states its implementation status.
Record the controls Stage 2 will sample and any exclusion whose justification is weak.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Stage 2: leadership, AI policy and roles
items.objective: Assess whether top management directs the AI management system through an AI policy, defined roles and a channel for concerns.

procedures.text: Interview top management on direction, resources and review of the AI management system.
Inspect the AI policy, its approval, communication, alignment with other policies and planned review.
Trace a sample of AI roles to documented responsibilities and authorities.
Test the channel for reporting concerns with a sample of reports or a walkthrough.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Stage 2: AI risk assessment and treatment
items.objective: Assess whether AI risks are assessed and treated by a defined process, at planned intervals and after significant changes.

procedures.text: Inspect the documented risk assessment process, its criteria and the approved risk acceptance levels.
Trace a sample of AI systems through risk identification, analysis, evaluation and treatment.
Verify that assessments were repeated at planned intervals and after significant changes.
Reconcile the risk treatment plan with the Statement of Applicability and residual-risk approvals.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Stage 2: AI system impact assessment
items.objective: Assess whether AI system impact assessments are defined, performed, recorded and consider individuals, groups and society.

procedures.text: Inspect the impact assessment process and the triggers for performing an assessment.
Sample recorded assessments for impacts on individuals, groups and society.
Verify that results feed risk treatment and are retained.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Stage 2: objectives, changes and support
items.objective: Assess whether AI objectives, planned changes, resources, competence, awareness, communication and documented information support the system.

procedures.text: Inspect AI objectives, their measures and the plans to reach them.
Inspect how changes to the management system are planned and carried out.
Sample competence and awareness records of people doing AI-related work.
Test communication arrangements and the control of documented information.
Inspect resource records for data, tooling, computing and people.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Stage 2: AI system life cycle and data
items.objective: Assess whether AI systems are developed, verified, deployed, operated and documented under controlled processes using controlled data.

procedures.text: Inspect operational planning and control of AI-related processes, including outsourced ones.
Trace a sample of AI systems from requirements through design, verification, validation and deployment.
Inspect operation and monitoring records, technical documentation and event logs of the sample.
Test data acquisition, quality, provenance and preparation records for the sample.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Stage 2: information, use and third parties
items.objective: Assess whether interested parties are informed, AI systems are used responsibly and third-party responsibilities are allocated.

procedures.text: Inspect user documentation, external reporting and incident communication for the sample.
Test processes and objectives for responsible use against the intended use of the sample.
Inspect supplier and customer arrangements for allocated AI responsibilities.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Stage 2: performance evaluation and improvement
items.objective: Assess whether performance is monitored, internal audits and management reviews are performed and nonconformities are corrected.

procedures.text: Inspect monitoring and measurement results and their evaluation.
Inspect the internal audit programme, a completed audit and its follow-up.
Inspect management review inputs, outputs and decisions.
Sample nonconformities for correction, root cause, corrective action and effectiveness review.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Exception, limitation and disagreement memo
items.objective: Evaluate unresolved exceptions and their effect on conclusion.

procedures.text: Describe criterion, missing/conflicting evidence and efforts to obtain it.
Assess alternatives, severity and potential pervasive effects.
Document management position and required report disclosure.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Nonconformity grading and corrective action review
items.objective: Record the grade of each nonconformity and the review of the organisation's corrections and corrective action plans.

procedures.text: List each nonconformity with the clause or control it concerns and its grade, with the reason for the grade.
Review the correction, root cause analysis and corrective action plan for each nonconformity.
Record which plans were accepted and which major nonconformities need verification on site.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Audit recommendation to the certification decision
items.objective: Record the audit team's recommendation and its basis for the certification decision.

procedures.text: Summarise the Stage 1 and Stage 2 conclusions and the Statement of Applicability review.
State the open nonconformities by grade and the status of their corrective actions.
State the recommendation and what the certification decision-maker must still verify.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.
